Copy result\stage-2 to polish\ and work only in polish\. Do not change any API behaviour or error codes. Keep every existing data-testid. No external assets, no CDN, everything bundled.

Goals:
1. Table icons: each search result shows an inline SVG of a table with chairs, one chair per seat, plus text such as "Table 1 - seats 2" and "Tables 1 + 2 together - seats 4". Combined tables show two joined tables.
2. A short plain-words legend near the search form: "Each card is one table. Seats = how many people fit."
3. Date: default search date = the visitor's local date (not UTC). If a past date is chosen, show a visible yellow notice "This date is in the past". Do NOT block or disable booking, because the spec forbids rejecting past starts.
4. Layouts: phone view (375px) is a single column with large tap targets and no horizontal scroll. Laptop view (1024px and wider) uses a two-column layout (form beside a grid of cards). Both must look finished.
5. Header on every page: "CResTE" and "Built by an autonomous AI agent factory on BAND".
6. Visible focus, labelled inputs, good contrast.

Definition of done:

- Reviewer takes real screenshots at 375px and 1280px with Playwright in WSL, and checks icons, legend, notice, header. Without screenshots the work is not accepted.
- Planner posts a final summary.
